captions.detailed: This 3D model features a folding bicycle crankset assembly consisting of a central bottom bracket spindle, a large black chainring, two metallic grey crank arms, and folding pedals. The crank arms extend in opposite directions from the central axis. Each pedal is mounted on a secondary hinge at the end of its crank arm, allowing it to fold flat to minimize the overall profile when stored.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a folding bicycle crankset with a central bottom bracket, a black chainring, grey alloy crank arms, and folding pedals. Ensure the assembly has revolute joints for the crank rotation and secondary folding hinges at the pedal bodies.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first creating a central bottom bracket spindle using Cylinder primitives. A large flat ring represents the chainring. The crank arms are extruded as tapered profiles. The folding pedals are modeled using Box and Cylinder primitives, then assembled onto the crank arms with revolute joints that represent both the main pedaling rotation and the folding hinge mechanisms.
